data.taskBrief:
TASK BRIEF: Search shared Notion pages and databases using the Notion API (Notion API)

FIT
  Fully. The supplied request provides the Notion search capability relevant to the integration goal. No requests were dropped.

AUTH
  Bearer token authentication.
  Header: Authorization: Bearer <notion_api_key>; supply the integration token for the `{{notion_api_key}}` value. Also send `Notion-Version: 2025-09-03`.

BASE URL
  https://api.notion.com/v1

STEPS
  1. POST /v1/search
     Params (JSON body):
       query: string — `Media Article`; place in the JSON body to search page and database titles/content.
       sort.direction: string — `ascending`; place in the JSON body.
       sort.timestamp: string — `last_edited_time`; place in the JSON body.
       Headers:
         Authorization: string — `Bearer <notion_api_key>`; authentication header.
         Notion-Version: string — `2025-09-03`; API-version header.
         Content-Type: string — `application/json`; request content-type header.
     Returns:
       200 OK with an object of type `list`, containing a `results` array. Each shown result includes `object`, `id`, timestamps, `parent`, `archived`, `properties`, and `url`; the example result is a page. The response also includes `next_cursor` and `has_more`.
     Threading:
       None

GOTCHAS
  - Send the body as JSON, not form data.
  - The collection defines `base_url` as `https://api.notion.com/v1`, while the request URL also appends `/v1/search`; resolving the placeholder literally produces `https://api.notion.com/v1/v1/search`. Verify the intended base URL before calling; use the schema's resulting URL only if that duplicated path is expected.
  - The integration must have access to the pages or databases being searched.
  - `notion_api_key` has no value in the supplied variables; provide the actual integration token at runtime.
  - The example response reports `has_more: false` and `next_cursor: null`; if a real response indicates more results, use its pagination fields as specified by the API.
